picks.title: Cross-Device Transfer of a Hospital-Trained Fetal Head Circumference Model to a Low-Cost Handheld Ultrasound Probe
picks.takeaway: 胎儿头围分割模型迁移至1350美元掌上超声，量化跨设备精度衰减
picks.why: 同次就诊18例配对扫描，域内2.34mm，掌上16.12mm恶化6.9倍

picks.title: DiffUltra: Task-Guided Pathology Synthesis for Large-Scale Real-World Lung Ultrasound Data
picks.takeaway: 任务引导潜扩散合成肺超声病灶，按无回声/低回声/高回声分区条件
picks.why: 针对病灶与解剖位置约束的超声数据扩增，附下游效用筛选

picks.title: Quantitative Ultrasound Characterizes Perfusion Trajectories in Healthy and Inflamed Gingival Wound Healing
picks.takeaway: 定量超声血流灌注轨迹，51例纵向彩色血流联合LASCA验证
picks.why: 用相位信息原始TRI数据估计速度加权色像素密度，可借鉴质控设计

picks.title: Measuring What Matters: A Causal Reliance Score for Histopathology Image Segmentation
picks.takeaway: 干预式评估框架，量化分割模型对前景结构vs背景域偏移的依赖
picks.why: 可迁移的因果稳健性质评思路，尚无超声验证
